resource.description: Art. 50 marking evidence: one signed pack for one generative output at a named URL, measured from its bytes. Detects C2PA and IPTC metadata only (C2PA manifest, assertion hashes, hard binding, claim signature; IPTC digitalSourceType); no watermark is read. States: DETECTED, NOT_DETECTED (not proof the output is unmarked) or UNCHECKABLE; never a legal determination. CSOAI is a C2PA member. Free unsigned preview; verification is free.

csoai.deliverable: one card-v0 leaf, surface art50.marking-evidence, ≤3KB payload, Ed25519-signed when the Pages key is present

scope.detects: C2PA and IPTC metadata only: a C2PA manifest (its assertion hashes, hard binding and claim signature) and the IPTC digitalSourceType field. No watermark, fingerprint or other kind of mark is read.
scope.not_detected: NOT_DETECTED means these methods found no C2PA or IPTC metadata in these bytes. It does not mean the output is unmarked: Article 50(2) is technology-neutral, so a watermark or another mark this pack cannot read may be present, and metadata is often stripped when a file is re-saved or uploaded.
scope.disclosure: CSOAI is a member of the C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity), whose specification is one of the two methods this pack reads.

gaps.c2pa.chain-trust: no C2PA trust list bundled; the leaf verifies its own signature only (anchor with c2patool --trust separately)
gaps.watermark.synthid: no public key-free detector: SynthID text detection needs the deployer's watermark keys (github.com/google-deepmind/synthid-text); image/audio/video detection is Google-hosted, not public
gaps.watermark.keyed: detectors published (Meta Stable Signature / Video Seal, github.com/facebookresearch/videoseal) but keyed to the deployer's private key; Digimarc/IMATAG proprietary
gaps.watermark.dwtdct: public detector exists (ShieldMnt/invisible-watermark, the Stable Diffusion 'SDV2' DWT-DCT mark) but is not implemented in this Function
gaps.text.watermark: no public detector for statistical text watermarks without the deployer's keys

rail.note: A settled receipt (facilitator /verify then /settle) unlocks the paid artefact. Verification of every artefact stays free.

csoai.pricing_terms: accepts[] carries a launch amount until 2027-01-11T00:00:00Z (end of 2027-01-10 UTC). From then this request asks its standard amount, the one in csoai_pricing.normal_amount_atomic. Read accepts[] on every call; your wallet signs exactly the amount shown and nothing more.

offer_receipt.verify: base64url-decode the JWS payload part, fetch https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json, take the publicKeyJwk.x of the verificationMethod whose id equals the header kid, and verify Ed25519 over `header.payload`. POST the compact string to /api/receipts/verify to have us do it, or run the same-site https://councilof.ai/verifier/verify_receipt.py checker. Default mode reads the public DID document; saved-key replay can be offline. Signature validity is not proof of settlement.
